audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Volibear rows 1-5 while the packet chart and the page's own why-strings say otherwise: whys[1] describes Kled out-trading at 2, whys[2] calls level 3 a skill trade, whys[5] and whys[6] hand the item stages to Kled. The mirror (kled__volibear) realigned all seven rows to the packet.
audit.why: Kled's level-2 mounted burst (Bear Trap yank into Violent Tendencies) beats a Volibear walk-up; Volibear owns 4-5 and 6; Kled reclaims it on items.
audit.corrected: Skill, Kled, Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Kled, Kled on both layers, ratings realigned.

audit.why: Spike windows are right: Volibear at 4-5 and at Stormbringer, Kled on his first item and on the remount cycle. Only the phase why-strings for the flipped rows needed to be brought in line.
audit.corrected: Spike entries kept; phases[1], [2], [5] and [6] why-strings rewritten to their new owners.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's Q was called a 'root' (it Stuns, and the stun lands on the attack), Sky Splitter was implied to be part of the engage, and Bear Trap on a Rope was described only as an 'engage hook' with no numbers — the packet flags zero sequencing cues in the matchup.
audit.why: Riot's text: Bear Trap damages and hooks, and the yank plus bonus damage only happens if the target stays shackled — breaking away denies it. Violent Tendencies is four attacks on 13s at rank 1; Jousting is a 13s dash that can be re-cast back through the target. Sky Splitter gives damage, a slow and a self-shield only if Volibear stands in the blast.
audit.corrected: Q stuns; the rope's yank is escapable; walk up while Violent Tendencies is spent; Sky Splitter buys the trade, it does not start it.

audit.why: The dismount win condition is right and is backed by Riot's own passive text: while dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and must earn courage back to remount.
audit.corrected: Stated explicitly in tldr and dontsFull[1].d instead of the generic filler that was there.

edits.before: Dismount him — Q-stun his foot form before he remounts. Volibear wins by trading around Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope and cashing the pattern: dismount him and all-in his foot form.
edits.after: Dismount him — off Skaarl he deals less damage and must earn courage back. Dodge the rope, Thundering Smash him while Violent Tendencies is spent, and double-bite the same mark for the heal.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope (Q): 11s at rank 1 — the yank only lands if the shackle holds, so walk out of the rope.

edits.before: His engage hook. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The yank only lands if the shackle holds — break away and it fizzles.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to you — kill him before courage refills.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Kled has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Bear Trap on a Rope (800 range, 11s) yanks you in for his four-attack Violent Tendencies — give him no walk-up.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Kled under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows and shields you only inside the blast — it is not a stun, so it buys the trade, it does not start it. Even level.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Kled to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on your first hit, but his item spike restores the mounted DPS lead — trade only when Skaarl is low.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Kled can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items his remount cycle and Violent Tendencies out-DPS your sustain — win by catching him dismounted, where his damage to you drops.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your Q root and W sustain out-trade a mounted Kled.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 your Q stun and Maul sustain out-trade a mounted Kled.

edits.before: Kled's early all-in with Q Bear Trap on a Rope pulls you in and his W Violent Tendencies shreds you, but by 4-5 your Q root into W sustain can out-trade a mounted Kled if you commit fully.
edits.after: Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope yanks you in and Violent Tendencies gives him four fast attacks, but by 4-5 the Thundering Smash stun into a double Frenzied Maul bite out-trades a mounted Kled.

edits.before: Catch him dismounted with Q root
edits.after: Catch him dismounted with Q stun

notes: spikes[2].text contains a garbled ability name, 'his R Chaaaaaa charge engage' — the real name is Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. I did not edit that string because a clean rewrite of it fell outside the length band once the full name was spelled out; QA may want to fix the name in place. Volibear's E carries a 'projectile' derived flag that contradicts Riot's own text (a bolt summoned at a location); no Wind Wall claim written. Whether tenacity meaningfully shortens Thundering Smash's stun is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
